# FP policy: floating-point multiply and add are evaluated separately in
# source order; compiler FMA contraction is NOT part of the encoder's
# defined behavior (-ffp-contract=off on GCC/Clang, /fp:precise on MSVC).
# Contraction is a compiler optimization not specified by the encoder
# algorithm, and allowing it would make encoded output depend on
# target/compiler behavior.
#
# Produced by the pristine reference encoder (r475 / git 05d97a5) built
# WITHOUT optimization (-O0) under the FP policy above. This file was
# re-frozen once when the FP policy was adopted (git commit 17eaecd) and
# re-frozen again for the MusicPack encoder version bump 1.30.1 -> 1.32.0:
# the encoder version is embedded in the SV8 EI (encoder info) block, so
# whole-file hashes change even though the codec output (audio packets,
# decoded PCM) is bit-identical. Generated with the patched reference
# encoder (tests/patch_reference.py normalizes its version to 1.32.0) on
# Apple clang 21 (arm64) at -O0. CI uses live-mode REF_MPCENC comparison
